name: What should I do immediately after discovering a roof leak after a storm?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after discovering a roof leak after a storm?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover a roof leak after a storm, the first step is to protect your belongings. Move furniture and valuables away from the leak or cover them with plastic. Place buckets or towels to catch dripping water to prevent further damage to floors and ceilings. Avoid touching damaged electrical fixtures. Contact a professional restoration company like First To Respond Restoration quickly to assess the damage and begin repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately protect belongings from water, place buckets to catch drips, and contact a professional restoration company for assessment.
